_meta.description: DarvaX satellite module configuration. OWNED BY DARVAX. ATHENA core reads ONLY the top-level 'enabled' flag, at the mount seam in athena/api/darvax_mount.py, and parses nothing else in this file. Every other key here is loaded and validated by DarvaX itself (athena/darvax/config.py). Do NOT add DarvaX fields to any athena.config model. DarvaX is a parallel advisory lane and never contributes to ATHENA scoring, confidence, risk, Decision, TradePlan, or universe.
_meta.status: EXPERIMENTAL / UNVALIDATED — the source methodology ships no backtest evidence; see ADR-010 DX-5.

_universe_note: SU-6 (ADR-011). DarvaX discovers over this ATHENA universe instead of every ingested instrument. Read as DATA through DarvaX's existing read-only port — DarvaX imports no ATHENA resolver, so ADR-010's pinned import surface is unchanged. Opted in 2026-08-16, once the universe had candles behind it: 2,604 resolved symbols, 2,191 with daily history and 1,843 meeting the 400-bar coverage requirement. Set to null to return to scanning every ingested instrument.

methodology._note: LIVE as of DX-3: the signal engine reads these values, and methodology_digest is persisted with every signal so a stored signal traces back to the exact parameters that produced it. Changing any value here changes the digest; earlier signals keep their old one and are NOT recomputed. Source deck contradicts itself on stop sizing (canonical Darvas 10% on p.67 vs DarvaX 1% on p.44) — both are selectable, defaulting to the canonical attributable rule, and DX-5 evidence decides. The box/swing/breakout/scan blocks are omitted here and take the defaults documented in docs/design/DARVAX-CONFIGURATION.md — they are live, not inert.
